subject: RE: Company wide demonstration / webinar
text:
Hey Lounes,

Apologies for the delay but I've been OOO for the last couple days.

It was a pleasure speaking with you and Benoit and I appreciate that while
curation would be powerful for your use case, the goal is to get more
buy-in from the group first.

*For sharing internally, we help with 3 major challenges when working with
large enterprises: *

1) Data curation - prioritising the best data: Filtering and finding the
right collections, frames, videos for your annotators to focus on. More
doesn't = better.

2) Annotation tooling for all: We're truly multimodal so that means,
images, videos, Lidar, Audio, Text and everything in-between. For
enterprises this solves the problem of "all oru teams are working in
different modalities".

3) Evaluation: Testing how your models perform against ground truths.

4) Workspaces: One account can have several workspaces keeping projects
separate and within the teams/BU's themselves. No need to buy different
licenses for everyone.

*I spoke with the team and we'd be happy to offer the following: *

1) A company wide demonstration / webinar where we can target the core use
cases for the group and find out who from 3DS would be interested in
looking at Encord more closely.
